extension.description: Automatically track movies and TV shows you watch in Kodi on your WeTrakr profile. Marks content as watched, syncs your viewing activity in real-time.
extension.news:
v1.3.10 - Fix: the WeTrakr entry did not show up in the context menu. It now shows on movies and episodes, from the library and from video add-ons.
v1.3.9 - Half-star ratings (6.5, 7.5...): turn them on in Settings > Rating. Off by default.
v1.3.8 - One watched threshold, set in WeTrakr (Settings > Kodi). The add-on applies it, and it starts from the value you had here. - When the next episode starts without Kodi stopping the previous one (playlist, Up Next, skip), the previous one is now closed and marked watched if you got far enough. Before, it could stay in Now Playing at 97-100 %.
v1.3.7 - Context menu: new Remove rating and Mark as Unwatched (remove the last play or all of them). - Mark as Watched and Rate can use a date and time of your choice instead of now (or the release date for watched). Turn it off in Settings > Context menu. - New setting to hide the WeTrakr entry from the context menu.
v1.3.6 - New option in Settings > Scrobbling: only scrobble files from the Kodi library. Turn it on if a video add-on (Red Light, POV...) already scrobbles its streams to WeTrakr, so they are not tracked twice. Off by default.
